title: ProofEvidence
description: Pluggable proof-class evidence carried in AttestationMetadata.proof_evidence. See spec §3.3 + computation-attestation-graduated-rigor-design.md.

issuer_signature.description: Optional convenience copy of the issuer's signature. The authoritative signature for witness-class proof is always the Holochain action header on the parent Content entry; this field is populated only when the issuer wants to embed it inline (e.g., for off-chain verification).

merkle_root.description: Required for audit class — Merkle root over Merkle-rooted inputs

algorithm_id.description: Required for audit/proof — pinned algorithm + version

zkml_proof.description: Required for proof class — zkML or equivalent cryptographic proof

multi_attestor_chain.description: Required for confirmation class — CIDs of corroborating attestations
